'Not getting H1B visas good for India': Fireside Chat with Piyush Goyal | ET Startup Awards 2026

‘Not Getting H-1B Visas Is Good For India’: In a fireside chat at the ET Startup Awards 2026, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal weighs in on the Trump administration’s H-1B visa crackdown and what it could mean for India. He also talks about India’s FTAs with the European Union and updates on the US-India trade pact. Goyal addresses India’s energy issues amid geopolitical uncertainty. Watch the full conversation for Piyush Goyal’s take on the H-1B debate and the opportunities it could open up for India.
